Only the two `Plastic_Road_Block` FBX variants are retained for the isolated
station-fire visual sample. They are presentation assets: their runtime
instances have no colliders and do not alter replay geometry, routing, or
passenger trajectories.

The source calls these objects plastic road blocks. Their hollow, interlocking
shape is visually suitable for the temporary water-filled barriers commonly
used around station maintenance and incident areas, but this presentation label
does not add an upstream `water_barrier` facility to the replay.
